items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: Gladys Knight and the Pips Christmas album. A 48-piece orchestra in the studio

ctx.x: There’s always someone that can cause anxiety, yes. And you never know what’s going to happen in the studio. So you can’t, you know you have to be iron clad. You have to

have a defense mechanism against anything that would ordinarily make you angry. You can’t — you don’t have time in a session to get angry. Oh here’s a story you might enjoy. Gladys Knight and the Pips Christmas album. A 48-piece orchestra in the studio, and so we spent at least the first two hours just rehearsing and getting the mix correct, getting the sounds and everything correct. So then we started in on the songs and we had all the songs done except one. There were three songs we were recording. Okay? So now…
